what_they_do: Zeit AI (ZeitMind) is a natural-language interface that connects to a company's ERP, CRM, databases, and other business systems (600+ integrations including SAP and AWS) so non-technical staff can pull data, build dashboards, and set up automated alerts without writing SQL or code. It replaces the manual cycle of business users requesting a report or dashboard from an analyst or IT and waiting days for a spreadsheet, letting them ask a question in plain language and get an answer or a live workflow instead.
vertical: Horizontal enterprise BI / data analytics, deployed via forward-deployed engineers across functions (finance, procurement, supply chain, pricing)
theme_fit_rationale: Zeit reads and writes across previously siloed systems of record (ERP, CRM, databases) via natural language and triggers downstream actions/alerts when it flags an issue, which is the core Theme 2 pattern of agents executing cross-functional workflows and consolidating fragmented tools rather than a single-function reporting tool.
